definitions.explanation: Describes something with very fine detail, precision, or resolution. Often used for visual quality, craftsmanship, or analysis.

examples.japanese: {精細|せいさい}な{描写|びょうしゃ}。
この{画面|がめん}は{非常|ひじょう}に{精細|せいさい}で{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: This screen is extremely fine-detailed and beautiful.

examples.japanese: {職人|しょくにん}が{精細|せいさい}な{技術|ぎじゅつ}で{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ{手作|てづく}りしている。
examples.english: Craftsmen make each piece by hand with meticulous technique.

notes:
A compound of {精|せい} (fine/refined) and {細|さい} (detailed/minute). Functions as a na-adjective, modifying nouns with な. Very commonly seen in technical contexts relating to display resolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精細|せいさい}な{描写|びょうしゃ}: detailed depiction
- {精細|せいさい}な{画像|がぞう}: high-resolution image
- {高|こう}{精細|せいさい}: high-definition, high-resolution
- {精細|せいさい}な{作業|さぎょう}: meticulous work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {緻密|ちみつ}: meticulous, elaborate — emphasizes thoroughness and careful planning
- {繊細|せんさい}: delicate, sensitive — can describe personality or aesthetics; broader usage
- {詳細|しょうさい}: detailed (information) — used for written/verbal details rather than visual fineness
- {制裁|せいさい}: sanctions, punishment — a homophone with unrelated meaning
